relations.rationale: The gathering for a quarterly showcase does not indicate who organizes the event.
The gathering being on Saturday morning is consistent with visitors arriving later that same day.
Layouts being on three tables doesn't specify which layout is closest to the door.
Table arrangement of layouts has no bearing on class assignments of Bo and Nell.
Table setup is unrelated to the time Zeno took to restore an engine.
Layouts spread across tables supports the idea that visitors later admired the miniature world across tables.
Hugo being the organizer has no bearing on relative heights.
As organizer, Hugo checking the attendance sheet is a natural organizer duty, supporting the claim.
Hugo's role as organizer doesn't determine the arrival time of latecomers.
Being the organizer doesn't relate to competition rankings.
Hugo organizing the event doesn't relate to Bo helping Zeno with lighting.
Finn arriving with the box supports that he later set it beside the entrance table.
Finn's early arrival with a box is unrelated to when Nell arrived relative to Bo.
Finn placing a box has no bearing on Hugo checking the attendance sheet.
Bo being a year older than Finn doesn't imply they share the same class.
Age difference between Bo and Finn is unrelated to Nell's competition ranking.
Bo's age relative to Finn doesn't relate to Bo helping Zeno with lighting.
Bo wheeling in scenery pieces is consistent with, but doesn't directly establish, the timing of Nell's arrival after Bo.
Scenery pieces including hills could support the largest layout being a mountain scene, though not explicitly connected.
Scenery pieces have no bearing on refreshment table timing.
